info.title: Leaves API
info.description:
REST API of the Leaves app (app API under `/api`), the M2M attendance API (`/api/attendence/...`, old contract) and the readiness probe.

App API errors answer with `ErrorBody` `{ statusCode, code, message }`; each operation lists its possible `code` values. Every route (also attendance and the health check) parses a JSON request body before routing and authentication and answers with `ErrorBody`: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` to malformed JSON or an unsupported charset / content encoding, 403 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` to a body over 100 KB. App API routes answer 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` to an unexpected failure. An unknown `/api` route is 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

Paths are relative to the app URL (`BASE_URL`, possibly with a path prefix). The server URL `..` is relative to this document, which the app serves at `<BASE_URL>/api/docs-json`, so it resolves to the app URL, prefix included. The interactive explorer (`/api/docs`, `/api/docs-json`) exists only outside production.

servers.description: The app itself (`BASE_URL`, prefix included), relative to this document at `<BASE_URL>/api/docs-json`

get.description:
Logged Toggl hours and approved leave codes per employee and day for one month (old contract kept 1:1, incl. the `attendence` spelling).

Params are parsed like the old app: any finite number (month checked first); a month outside 1–12 rolls over (`2024/13` = January 2025, `2024/0` = December 2023) and then carries no leave codes. A finite value whose month lies outside the JS `Date` range is a 400 with the old texts: `Year is not a number.` when the year alone is out of range (`1e20/3`), else `Month is not a number.` (`2024/1e300`).

Errors use the old bodies, not `ErrorBody`: 400 / 500 `{ "message": ... }`; 401 (missing or wrong Basic credentials, also with a Bearer token) has an empty body and no `WWW-Authenticate` header. No CORS headers.

Exception: like every route, a JSON request body is parsed before routing and authentication, and its errors answer with the app-wide `ErrorBody`: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` (malformed JSON, unsupported charset or content encoding) and 403 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (over 100 KB). So a 400 body is `AttendanceError` or `ErrorBody`.

**Error codes**:

- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (403)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Year, e.g. `2026`: a finite number within the JS `Date` range, else 400 `Year is not a number.`.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month 1–12, e.g. `12`. Other finite numbers roll over; one whose month falls outside the JS `Date` range is 400 `Month is not a number.`.

200.description: Attendance of all employees listed in the SSO directory.

400.description: A param is not a finite number or lies outside the JS `Date` range (month checked first). Before routing: `VALIDATION_FAILED` (`ErrorBody`, see the API description).

401.description: Missing or wrong M2M Basic credentials: empty body, no `WWW-Authenticate`.

post.description:
Revokes this browser's refresh token family and clears the cookie. Idempotent: 204 also without a cookie or with an unknown one.

**Error codes**:

- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (403)
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500)

Set-Cookie.description: `refresh_token=...; Path=<BASE_URL path>/api/auth; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict`: cleared (`Max-Age=0`).

post.description:
Rotates the refresh token from the cookie and returns a new access token. A Bearer token is ignored. Any failure except a missing cookie also clears the cookie; reusing a rotated token revokes the whole token family.

**Error codes**:

- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_MISSING` (401)
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID` (401)
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED` (401)
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED` (401)
- `USER_DEACTIVATED` (401)
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (403)
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500)

Set-Cookie.description: `refresh_token=...; Path=<BASE_URL path>/api/auth; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict`: the rotated refresh token.

get.description:
Kubernetes readiness probe: 200 while MongoDB answers, else 500 with the error message (old body format, not `ErrorBody`). HEAD answers the same status without a body. Not cached. Like every route, a JSON request body is parsed before routing; its errors use `ErrorBody`, not the `HealthCheck` body: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` (malformed JSON, unsupported charset or content encoding), 403 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (over 100 KB).

**Error codes**:

- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400)
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (403)

m2mBasic.description: M2M credentials (`M2M_USERNAME` / `M2M_PASSWORD`); attendance only. A failure is 401 with an empty body and no `WWW-Authenticate`.

refreshCookie.name: refresh_token
refreshCookie.description: Rotating refresh token (AUTH-02): HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, path `<BASE_URL path>/api/auth`. Set by the login and every refresh.

confirmEmail.description: The target user's email, typed by the admin; compared trimmed and lowercased.

AttendanceDay.description: One day of the month (index 0 = day 1).

leave.description: Codes of the approved leaves on this work day, comma-separated (`D8` annual, `D4` annual half day, `PN` sickness, `L` doctor, `I` other); empty when none, or when the month param is not an integer 1–12.

contractType.description: Contract type from the SSO directory; absent when SSO has none.

AttendanceResponse.description: Monthly attendance of all employees (ATT-01, old format).

attendence.description: Keyed by the employee name from the SSO directory.

AuditPageDto.description: One page of audit entries, newest first.

AuthConfigDto.description: Settings the SPA needs before sign-in (AUTH-01).

ErrorBody.description: Error body of every app API error (not used by the attendance API and the health check).

ExportAuditEntry.description: An audit entry in the GDPR export.

redacted.description: `true`: `details` held another user's data and was removed.

ExportLeave.description: A leave in the GDPR export.

idToken.description: Google ID token (JWT) from Google Identity Services.

numDays.description: Work days of the leave (0.5 for a half day).

LeaveSummaryDto.description: The caller's approved leaves per year (descending) and type (SUM-01).

LeaveSummaryTypeDto.description: Work days of one leave type in one year.

LeaveSummaryYearDto.description: One year; `byType` is empty without approved leaves.

SessionDto.description: Session started by the Google login or a refresh (AUTH-02). The refresh token is set in the `refresh_token` cookie.

UserExportFile.description: GDPR export of one user's data (NFR-07), sent as a JSON attachment.

UserRefDto.description: A user embedded in another object; never carries the email.
